title: Talk to your data: ask Frigade about your own workspace
summary: You can now query your Frigade data directly instead of reading it off the dashboard. This is useful for queries such as who your heaviest users are, how many questions the assistant answered this mon
body_markdown:
[All updates](https://frigade.com/updates)


You can now query your Frigade data directly instead of reading it off the dashboard. This is useful for queries such as who your heaviest users are, how many questions the assistant answered this month, and figuring out what the recurring themes are with your users.


Answers come back as clickable envelopes, so you can open the underlying record straight from the response.
